title: Local government 2025 report and dashboard
manual_reason: Confirmed non-deterministic on 2026-07-20/21: across 10 discovery attempts, the landing page resolved 13-14 real report PDF assets only twice (both immediately after a code change), and returned a stripped 2-link version (font + stylesheet only, no report links) the other 8 times. Root-page content hash differed between the two variants (d6dee44961dc vs 32ed63159c77) for the identical URL and identical request, indicating server-side adaptive behavior (most likely bot-mitigation serving reduced content after the first few requests from an IP), not a code bug. Classified flaky_unreliable rather than discovered_only or no_public_bulk_export - neither would be honest given the observed ~20% success rate. Orchestrator now allows up to flaky_max_attempts sparse retries with flaky_gap_seconds between attempts; if still empty, falls back to flaky_unreliable and suggests procure_browser_session.py.
